description: The plot illustrates the loss trajectories of two models — “Vanilla” (a standard Transformer) and “SepLLM” (the proposed method) — as a function of training time in seconds. The x-axis, labeled “Training Time (s),” spans from 0 to 250,000 seconds with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.40 to 2.75, with grid lines and tick marks at 0.05 intervals. The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 2.75 loss at 0 seconds and gradually declines to about 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The “SepLLM” model is shown with a red line and circular markers, also solid; it starts at roughly 2.72 loss and decreases more steeply, reaching approximately 2.49 by 250,000 seconds. A green dashed horizontal line at loss = 2.50 serves as a reference, and a green dashed rectangle highlights the region where SepLLM reaches this threshold at around 200,000 seconds, while Vanilla reaches it later, near 250,000 seconds — indicated by a “1.26×” annotation suggesting SepLLM achieves the same loss level 1.26 times faster. Both lines show a consistent downward trend, with SepLLM maintaining a lower loss than Vanilla across the entire training duration.
